papers.summary:
-  We classified 34 files: 19 data, 13 code, 2 documentation.
-  We found 5 tabular data files and extracted 31 columns from 5 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 1 study group (ex1), plus 2 collection-level files (README/ro-crate metadata). We ran automated data-quality checks on 31 columns; 11 columns have at least one potential issue (10 columns of free text that may contain personal detail; 1 column whose name contains file-illegal characters or is excessively long).

-  We found 110 tabular data files and extracted 858 columns from 106 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 1 study group (ex1), plus 4 collection-level files (README/ro-crate metadata).
-  4 files read as a table but are not a usable rectangular dataset (outputs/vic_case_review_2026-10/CASE_REVIEW.xlsx: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; outputs_v2/tables/supplementary_stats_summary.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; Coronial-NLP-Analysis-v2.1.0.zip/Coronial-NLP-Analysis-v2.1.0/outputs/vic_case_review_2026-10/CASE_REVIEW.xlsx: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; Coronial-NLP-Analysis-v2.1.0.zip/Coronial-NLP-Analysis-v2.1.0/outputs_v2/tables/supplementary_stats_summary.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables). No columns were extracted and they were not sent to the LLM. Share the underlying data as a plain rectangular table (one header row, one column per variable) with a codebook: outputs/vic_case_review_2026-10/CASE_REVIEW.xlsx, outputs_v2/tables/supplementary_stats_summary.csv, Coronial-NLP-Analysis-v2.1.0.zip/Coronial-NLP-Analysis-v2.1.0/outputs/vic_case_review_2026-10/CASE_REVIEW.xlsx, Coronial-NLP-Analysis-v2.1.0.zip/Coronial-NLP-Analysis-v2.1.0/outputs_v2/tables/supplementary_stats_summary.csv. We ran automated data-quality checks on 858 columns; 64 columns have at least one potential issue (50 columns whose name contains file-illegal characters or is excessively long; 8 columns with no observed values (entirely empty); 6 columns of free text that may contain personal detail). 6 of 6 spreadsheet files have at least one formatting issue (colour coding, merged cells, empty rows/columns, or an offset header).
